comment: Repositories that receive the vendored rcl and rcl-converge skills from npm rcl. None today: since CLI-171 the Infra One repositories (harness-cli, infra-one-ios, browser-extension, infraone-signal-capture, docs-infra-one) vendor the /rcl and /rcl-converge skills from the infraone fork instead (allocator-one/harness-cli, scripts/vendor-skills.mjs), whose text differs from this repository's. A consumer added here would have its skills overwritten by npm rcl's after every release. allocator-one keeps its own repository-specific lineage and is deliberately absent.
